examples.en: By broader context, I mean how the concert relates to some period in music history.
examples.zh: 我所说的广义，意思是将音乐会联系到某个音乐历史时期上来。

examples.en: Later, I developed a broader theory of what separates the two general classes of learners—helpless versus mastery-oriented.
examples.zh: 后来，我提出了一个更广泛的理论来区分这两类常见的学习者——无助型和掌控型。
